async def act(page):
    # Click the 'Author' button to open the filter dropdown
    author_button = page.get_by_role('button', name='Author', exact=True)
    await author_button.click()
    # Wait for the dropdown to appear
    await page.wait_for_timeout(1000)
    # Select 'Anthony' from the dropdown. Use get_by_role with 'option' or similar.
    # Try to find 'Anthony' as an option or link in the dropdown.
    anthony_option = page.get_by_role('option', name='Anthony', exact=True).first
    if await anthony_option.count() > 0:
        await anthony_option.click()
    else:
        # If not found as option, try as link or other element
        anthony_element = page.get_by_text('Anthony', exact=True).first
        if await anthony_element.count() > 0:
            await anthony_element.click()
        else:
            print('Author Anthony not found in filter dropdown.')
    # Wait for the page to update after filtering
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    # Filter by date range using the searchbox
    searchbox = page.get_by_role('searchbox', name='Search by message', exact=True)
    # Use GitLab date query syntax for August to September 2022
    await searchbox.fill('after:2022-08-01 before:2022-09-30')
    await searchbox.press('Enter')
    # Wait for page to update
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    # Count commit links using JavaScript evaluation to avoid CSS selectors
    count = await page.evaluate('''() => {
        const links = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('a'));
        const commitLinks = links.filter(link => link.href.includes('/-/commit/'));
        return commitLinks.length;
    }''')
    # Return the count as a string for terminate_with_result
    return str(count)
